name: Translate to Hebrew
description: A voice speaks what you say in Hebrew. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 189 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Hebrew model from the Argos Translate package index: Argos Translate (Argos Open Technologies), released under MIT or CC0 (argos-translate issue #533). Trained on OPUS data; includes a Stanza English tokenizer (Apache-2.0). Voice: Piper voice he_IL-saspeech-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, see its model card.
